candidate_decisions.reason: All five nominated branches land through focus carriers and distinct pericope contacts. The focus's two uses of forgetting remain distinct: the first recalls what left the addressees' attention, while the divine first-person use applies deliberate abandonment; the meeting is also faced as a concrete encounter and as harm undergone. The discarded-object branch is retained only as an analogy through the verb's object relation, not as a literal noun sense in the focus.

The focus supports bodily tasting, directly undergone punishment, and persistence through al-khuld; the pericope's repeated taste command and return from attempted escape sharpen those readings. Three candidate branches do not fit their actual carriers: the al-khuld noun is not one of the specified clinging constructions, and the punishment noun عذاب is explicitly outside the abstention and withholding branches.

branch_exclusions.reason: This branch is limited to specified constructions such as أخلد إلى الأرض, أخلد بالمكان, and أخلد بصاحبه; its source explicitly excludes الخلود as bare permanence. The focus carrier is the genitive abstract noun ٱلْخُلْدِ, with no required complement or attached construction to carry clinging or adhesion.

The branch denotes a person or animal abstaining from food and drink, and its source explicitly excludes العذاب بمعنى العقوبة. The focus carrier is the punishment noun عَذَابَ; ذُوقُوا can trigger the contrast but cannot supply this branch's carrier.

The branch requires the withholding or abstention constructions represented by أعذب عن الشيء / أعذبته عن الأمر, and its source explicitly excludes punishment and painfulness. The focus has the noun عَذَابَ, not a matching branch form or complement.

findings.title: The forgotten encounter returns as abandonment and harm
findings.claim: The pericope makes the focus's forgotten meeting present: the wrongdoers acknowledge seeing and hearing at their Lord and ask to be returned in 32:12, while the focus answers their prior neglect with the declaration that they have been left. The encounter they set aside thus becomes a face-to-face reckoning and a harmful outcome they must undergo.
findings.mechanism: The focus noun لِقَآءَ carries encounter senses that meet the scene at 32:12 and the punishment reiterated at 32:20. The two نَسِيَ occurrences preserve memory-loss and deliberate-abandonment facets: the first governs the named meeting, and the divine first-person form answers the addressees' plea by leaving them without aid. The discarded-object branch enters through an analogy in which the verb's meeting-object is treated as something set aside; the later punishment makes that encounter arrive as harm.
findings.reader_payoff: The repeated language of forgetting now carries a return: what the addressees neglected is the very encounter before which they plead, and the divine reply makes their former abandonment answerable as an experience of harm.
findings.containment: The appointed accountability encounter remains intact. The discarded-item facet is an analogy for how the meeting is treated, since the focus uses a verb rather than a noun meaning discarded baggage; the memory-loss facet also remains within the focus's accountable-neglect setting.

epistemic.reason: Trusted channel support nominates the distinctions, and the focus carriers align with the supplied branches. The contextual contacts come from exact pericope text; the discarded-object relation is explicitly analogical, and two branch identities are marked qualified in the packet.

findings.title: Punishment is tasted as a continuing ordeal
findings.claim: The pericope turns the focus's punishment into a bodily and enduring experience: the two commands to taste meet the punishment named as their object, and 32:20 repeats that command after describing every attempted exit ending in return to the Fire.
findings.mechanism: The focus's ذُوقُوا carries the mouth's tasting image and the broader sense of direct experience; عَذَابَ gives that experience its punitive object, while ٱلْخُلْدِ marks its persistence. The supplied 32:20 scene independently repeats tasting punishment and shows return after attempted escape, so the tasting is read as an ordeal that continues rather than a brief contact.
findings.reader_payoff: The command is heard as something the addressees must undergo in their bodies and meet repeatedly, with the permanence word keeping the punishment from sounding momentary.
findings.containment: The tasting image remains metaphorical because the focus's object is punishment rather than food. The retained reading is direct bodily experience and duration; the candidate's abstention, weaning, and clinging senses are outside the actual noun and construction forms.

epistemic.reason: The trusted channel supports the sensory and duration relations, and the exact 32:20 context supplies a repeated taste-and-return scene. The bodily image is stated as metaphorical pressure, not literal eating.

findings.title: Deeds frame different modes of reception
findings.claim: The focus keeps its plain relation between punishment and what the addressees used to do. Across the supplied pericope, the same work formula also accompanies hidden recompense and a provisioned shelter for the righteous, so the focus's tasted punishment can be read as a contrasting mode of reception prepared in relation to prior work.
findings.mechanism: The focus's causal work clause contacts the matching work formula in 32:17 and 32:19. In those contexts it stands beside recompense, a sheltering destination, and provisions prepared for arrival; in the focus it stands beside punishment and the repeated command to taste. The HFT trace infers that the common work-to-outcome relation frames outcomes as modes of reception, while the tasting carrier makes the focus side personally inhabited.
findings.reader_payoff: The repeated work formula links action to the way an outcome is received: the positive contexts show hidden reward and provisioned lodging, while the focus makes punishment something personally tasted.
findings.containment: The focus remains a punishment tied to habitual deeds. The reception symmetry is an attributed contextual inference; the packet's simpler legal-equivalence reading remains live, and unresolved branches have no supplied lexical gloss or facet.

epistemic.reason: The exact Arabic anchors and HFT word coordinates are supplied and each trace returns to focus words, but the reader identity is legacy_unbound, target morphology is absent, and the reception symmetry is explicitly an inference.
